name: netMaxcard_finite_iff
statement: X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) : netMaxcard T F U n < ⊤ ↔ ∃ s : Finset X, IsDynNetIn T F U n s ∧ (s.card : ℕ∞) = netMaxcard T F U n

name: netMaxcard_eq_zero_iff
statement: X → X) (F : Set X) (U : SetRel X X) (n : ℕ) : netMaxcard T F U n = 0 ↔ F = ∅

name: coverMincard_le_netMaxcard
statement: X → X) (F : Set X) [U.IsRefl] [U.IsSymm] (n : ℕ) : coverMincard T F (U ○ U) n ≤ netMaxcard T F U n

have_tree.name: larger_net
have_tree.type: IsDynNetIn T F U n (insert x s)

name: coverEntropyInf_eq_iSup_netEntropyInfEntourage
statement: coverEntropyInf T F = ⨆ U ∈ 𝓤 X, netEntropyInfEntourage T F U

name: coverEntropy_eq_iSup_netEntropyEntourage
statement: coverEntropy T F = ⨆ U ∈ 𝓤 X, netEntropyEntourage T F U
